hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western Africa, bordering the Gulf of Guinea, between Cote d'Ivoire and Togo || mostly low plains with dissected plateau in south-central area || Lake Volta is the world's largest artificial lake (manmade reservoir) by surface area (8,482 sq km; 3,275 sq mi); the lake was created after the Akosombo Dam was completed in 1965 || Resources: gold, timber, industrial diamonds, bauxite, manganese, fish, rubber, hydropower, petroleum, silver, salt, limestone || Exports: gold, crude petroleum, cocoa beans, manganese ore, cocoa paste (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly low plains with dissected plateau in south-central area || Western Africa, bordering the Gulf of Guinea, between Cote d'Ivoire and Togo

climate.excerpt: tropical; warm and comparatively dry along southeast coast; hot and humid in southwest; hot and dry in north || dry, dusty, northeastern harmattan winds from January to March; droughts

economy.excerpt: West African lower-middle income economy; major gold, oil and cocoa exporter; macroeconomic challenges following nearly four decades of sustained growth; recent progress in debt restructuring, fiscal reforms, financial stability, and curbing runaway inflation under 2023-26 IMF credit facility program || Exports: gold, crude petroleum, cocoa beans, manganese ore, cocoa paste (2023) || Industries: mining, lumbering, light manufacturing, aluminum smelting, food processing, cement, small commercial ship building, petroleum
